h: FIFA confirms US-led bid for 2031 Women's World Cup, UK to host 2035
p: FIFA has confirmed the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica as hosts of the 2031 Women's World Cup, the first with 48 teams. The four UK nations will host the 2035 edition.
body: FIFA has officially named the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica as joint hosts of the 2031 Women's World Cup, while England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland will host the 2035 tournament.

The hosts were confirmed on Monday, 23 November 2026, at an Extraordinary FIFA Congress held virtually with representatives of its 211 member associations. Both joint bids were approved by acclamation, having been the only candidates.
The 2031 edition will be the first Women's World Cup with 48 teams and 104 matches, bringing it in line with the men's tournament, and the first to be hosted across four countries.
It will be the third time the US has hosted the Women's World Cup, after 1999 and 2003, and the first time for Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica.
more: 2031 will be the first 48-team Women's World Cup.
The four UK nations will host in 2035.
Both bids were approved by acclamation.
